verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a speech API platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented sandbox, test-mode keys, or isolated non-production environment. The API Playground, free credit, project management and self-hosting are adjacent features or user-side arrangements, not a product-provided sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
